name: Dalu Hawaiian BBQ
notes: MenuStar first-party ordering system linked from restaurant's own order site (orderdaluhawaiianbbqcajon.com), restaurant_id 120119. Pulled both categories (BEVERAGES, MENU) via POST to themenustar6.com/webspace/functions/restaurant.php. Cent distribution is unusually scattered (.25 37%, .75 13%, .95 8%, .29 8%, .55 8%, etc.) - ran divisor sweep 1.00-1.35, no divisor produced a cleaner round-dollar fit than baseline, so no markup found. 'Value Menu' items are uniformly $15.29 across different dishes which reads as an intentional fixed price point, not corruption. Filed at medium confidence given the odd cent pattern.
